column1: # City-table set (2026-11-12): tests the US city table (usCityNames) itself.
# 40 names drawn by a seeded sample (seed 1112) from the 214 the table gained
# since f254c4d, each written bare as a board would; and 20 distractors that
# put a table name beside a foreign country or region (it must not read as
# US), beside a US state (it must), or inside a longer foreign name (a
# street, a district). Hand-labelled from what the name is, not from any
# verdict. Columns, tab-separated: label, remote, location, stratum,
# postings (0: constructed, not from the ledger).
#   label  U: every option is in the United States; M: some are, some are not;
#          N: none is; A: as likely US as not; ?: names no readable place
